arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:17}|1%|]{/c}
{/if}Summon a spear of lightning that seeks out enemies for {c_number}[{SF_2}|1|]{/c} seconds, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage per hit.

You may have up to {c_number}[SF_58]{/c} {c_important}Lightning Spears{/c} active at a time.

{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} arcs to {c_number}[SF_47]{/c} additional surrounding targets dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_CHAIN_DAMAGE}{/c} damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.

{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} fires {c_number}[SF_57]{/c} spears that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage Stun enemies for {c_number}[SF_40|1|]{/c} |4seconds;second. Enemies can only be Stunned this way once every {c_number}[SF_43]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill, deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} seconds

{c_important}Burning{/c} enemies hit by {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} explode for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DETONATE_DAMAGE}{/c}.
When a {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} Critically Strikes, its duration is increased by {c_number}[SF_39|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_44} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. This bonus is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_45} * 100|%x|]{/c} each time {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} deals damage to an enemy.
{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_46*100|%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance.
